system.description:
Named Unique (heavy flail +2). Once per day, ring its chain: creatures of your choice within 30ft make a Will save (Cha DC) or are Frightened until the end of their next turn and must move away from you on it.

Quirk (Tempting): Disadvantage on saves against offers of power. A Red Waste warlord swung it at the Boldock Wall; the Wall-Knights who took it keep it locked away at Fort Talon.

Monsters & Treasure, Named Uniques. Saves use DC 10 + half your level + the attribute named.
